evidence: Paid Ads and Social Media use 76% of the budget but cost INR 156 per lead, versus INR 19 for Referral and Email.
recommendation: Move part of the Paid Ads and Social Media budget to Referral (a referral program) and Email, and track results by channel.
estimated_impact: Moving 15% of that spend (INR 182K) could add about 3,540 leads a year (+17%), even if the new channels keep only 50% of their current efficiency.

evidence: Inquiries answered within 4 hours convert at 57% (IT) and 51% (digital), against much lower rates for slower replies, yet 70% and 67% of inquiries wait longer.
recommendation: Set a 4-hour first-response target and alert the team on new inquiries, then prioritize by budget, channel (Referral first), and reply speed. The lead-scoring model is not yet reliable enough to rank individual inquiries.
estimated_impact: If slower replies converted at the 4-hour rate, that would mean about 234 more deals (+22%) and roughly INR 59 million in deal value.

evidence: Mobile visitors are 63% of traffic but convert at 2.68%, against 5.66% on desktop.
recommendation: Review the mobile experience of the application and inquiry forms (speed, form length, button placement) and test changes.
estimated_impact: Reaching 75% of the desktop rate on mobile would add about 236 conversions a year (+27%).

evidence: Large inquiries (over INR 500K) are 12% of inquiries but 52% of deal value, all in IT services, and Cybersecurity has the highest conversion rate and budgets of the IT services but ranks only number 23 by demand.
recommendation: Give Large inquiries a dedicated fast track and a senior contact, and promote Cybersecurity to Enterprise and SME clients.
estimated_impact: Each +5 points of conversion on Large inquiries is worth about INR 14.0 million.

evidence: No student with under 60% attendance completed (150 students), and offline students complete 9 points more often than online students.
recommendation: Flag students whose attendance drops toward 60% and contact them early, and offer more offline or hybrid cohorts for the biggest programs.
estimated_impact: Recovering half of the 150 low-attendance students would add about 46 completions (+4%).

evidence: Billing Queries take 27 hours to resolve (others: 22), escalated requests score 2.83 in satisfaction versus 4.02 when resolved, and only 92% of Critical requests meet an 8-hour target.
recommendation: Create a faster billing process, find why requests escalate, and add alerts for Critical requests approaching the target.
estimated_impact: Fewer escalations would lift satisfaction directly, since escalated requests score more than a full point lower.

evidence: Demand peaks at different times: internships in January, IT inquiries in March, and training and digital in July.
recommendation: Plan staffing, trainers, and campaigns around each line's peak, and use the Q4 2026 scenarios for capacity planning.
estimated_impact: A planning range of 1,602 to 1,922 applications, enrollments, and inquiries for Q4 2026.

evidence: All figures come from a simulated dataset, and one year of history cannot separate growth from seasonality.
recommendation: Replace the simulated data with real tracking (channel attribution, response times, attendance), run A/B tests before large changes, and re-fit the models quarterly.
estimated_impact: Turns these scenarios into measured results.
